annotations.title: Status of a roof plan PDF job (solar roof check)

description: Where a roof_report_pdf_start job is: rendering (poll again in 10 seconds), done (summary, which PDF it is and price_shown: whether the file shows a price of Sky Solar's), failed (with a reason code: plan_error, render_error, render_lost) or unknown (wrong or expired job_id). A tool error here means the call itself failed, not the job.
name: roof_report_pdf_status
